# Data

**Read:** [CS336 L13](http://cs336.stanford.edu/spring2025-lectures/?trace=var/traces/lecture_13.json)–[14](http://cs336.stanford.edu/spring2025-lectures/?trace=var/traces/lecture_14.json); [CS336 A4](https://github.com/stanford-cs336/assignment4-data); GPT-3 and Llama 3 data sections

**Must master:** Common Crawl → usable text: language ID, quality filters, exact and fuzzy dedup (MinHash), PII removal; data mixing and curriculum

**HAND implementation:** MinHash dedup on a small corpus (HAND→AGENT)

**Known interview question:** "Design a filtering pipeline and tell me how you'd validate it."
